basic_info.description: Step into the timeless elegance of this stunning Art Deco gem, nestled in the vibrant heart of Russian Hill. Perched high on the 17th floor, condo #1702 offers breathtaking panoramic views from the living and dining areas, capturing the iconic sights of San Francisco's downtown, the Bay Bridge, and San Francisco Bay. The spacious living room is bathed in natural light, with multiple windows framing these magnificent vistas like a piece of art. Just off the living space, the inviting dining area seamlessly transitions into an updated kitchen, creating a perfect flow for entertaining. The additional room, ideal for a home office or retreat, adds versatility to the layout. The generously sized bedroom, with picturesque views of Coit Tower, easily accommodates a king-size bed and features a walk-in closet. It leads into the beautifully appointed Art Deco bathroom, complete with a separate tub and shower for ultimate relaxation. Residents of the esteemed 1101 Green Street enjoy unmatched amenities, including 24-hour doorman service, elevator access, valet garage parking, and convenient in-building laundry facilities, ensuring comfort and peace of mind at every turn.
